title: UFO Docuseries: A Balanced Look at the Pentagon's Secret Research
description: The new Hulu‑streaming docuseries "UFO" brings together investigative journalism, government data, and scientific insight to examine the Pentagon's long‑hidden research programmes on unidentified aerial phenomena. By drawing on the credibility of former governors, researchers, and the acclaimed journalist Leslie Kean, the series provides a sober, evidence‑based perspective that invites viewers to judge for themselves what these sightings truly mean for humanity's place in the cosmos.
